recommendation_2: Apply Bfloat16 Autocast using torch.amp.autocast during the training and inference loops on the CPU.
rationale_2: Lowers memory bandwidth pressure and reduces Joules by utilizing 16-bit floating point operations without the stability issues of FP16.
recommendation_3: Perform L1 Unstructured Pruning on the fc layer with amount=0.4, followed immediately by prune.remove to make the sparsity permanent.
rationale_3: Removes 40% of the least significant weights in the linear layer, reducing the model's state_dict size for more efficient transmission in Flower.
recommendation_4: Execute Layer Scaling by reducing the implicit dimensions of the fc layer if an MLP is used, specifically setting hidden dimensions to 32.
rationale_4: The current MLP experiments (128 and 64 neurons) increase the parameter count; scaling down to 32 minimizes the RAM footprint while maintaining MNIST classification viability.
